```{r, results='asis', echo=FALSE, warning=FALSE}
# ===============================
# All Calculation Rows
# ===============================

suppressPackageStartupMessages({
  library(knitr)
  library(kableExtra)
  library(dplyr)
  library(stringr)
})

knitr::asis_output(paste0(
  "\\newpage\n",
  "\\begin{landscape}\n"
))

knitr::asis_output(paste0(
  "\\noindent\n",
  "\\begin{mytitleboxL}\n",
  "\\Large\\bfseries\\color{white} Loss/Gain Calculation Results\n",
  "\\end{mytitleboxL}\n\n"
))

# Prepare data with cleaned column names
df_clean <- params$saved_results_df
# Standardise column names: replace underscores and dots with spaces
colnames(df_clean) <- gsub("[_.]", " ", colnames(df_clean))

# ------------------------------
# Identify and escape cells with special LaTeX characters
# ------------------------------

latex_specials <- c("%", "&", "_", "#", "{", "}", "$", "^", "~", "\\")
has_special_chars <- function(x) {
  sapply(latex_specials, function(char) str_detect(x, fixed(char))) |> rowSums() > 0
}

df_clean <- df_clean %>%
  mutate(across(where(is.character), ~ ifelse(has_special_chars(.),
                                              cell_spec(., "latex", escape = TRUE),
                                              .)))

# ---- Now create LaTeX-containing columns ----
df_clean <- df_clean |>
  dplyr::mutate(
    Impact = paste0(round(.data[["Impact Mean"]], 2), " [",
                    round(.data[["Impact P5"]], 2), ", ",
                    round(.data[["Impact P95"]], 2), "]"),
    Offset = paste0(round(.data[["Offset Mean"]], 2), " [",
                    round(.data[["Offset P5"]], 2), ", ",
                    round(.data[["Offset P95"]], 2), "]"),
    NPBV   = ifelse(.data[["NPBV P5"]] < 0,
                    cell_spec(
                      paste0(round(.data[["NPBV Mean"]], 2), " [",
                             round(.data[["NPBV P5"]], 2), ", ",
                             round(.data[["NPBV P95"]], 2), "]"),
                      "latex", color = "red"),
                    paste0(round(.data[["NPBV Mean"]], 2), " [",
                           round(.data[["NPBV P5"]], 2), ", ",
                           round(.data[["NPBV P95"]], 2), "]"))
  ) |>
  dplyr::select(
    `Biodiversity Type` = `biodiversity type`,
    `Component`         = `biodiversity component`,
    `Attribute`         = `biodiversity attribute`,
    `Measurement Unit`  = `measurement unit`,
    Impact, Offset, NPBV
  )



# ------------------------------
# Build LaTeX table
# ------------------------------
df_clean |>
  kbl(booktabs = TRUE, escape = FALSE,  # escape = FALSE required for cell_spec
      caption = "Biodiversity Offset Results", row.names = FALSE) |>
  kable_styling(latex_options = c("striped", "hold_position"), font_size = 9)


knitr::asis_output("\\end{landscape}")


```


```{r, results='asis', echo=FALSE, warning=FALSE}
# ===============================
# Summary Table
# ===============================

suppressPackageStartupMessages({
  library(knitr)
  library(kableExtra)
  library(dplyr)
  library(stringr)
})

knitr::asis_output(paste0(
  "\\newpage\n",
  "\\begin{landscape}\n"
))

knitr::asis_output(paste0(
  "\\noindent\n",
  "\\begin{mytitleboxL}\n",
  "\\Large\\bfseries\\color{white} Loss/Gain Calculation Summary\n",
  "\\end{mytitleboxL}\n\n"
))

# Prepare data
df_clean <- params$summary_results_df
colnames(df_clean) <- gsub("[_.]", " ", colnames(df_clean))

# Identify LaTeX special characters
latex_specials <- c("%", "&", "_", "#", "{", "}", "$", "^", "~", "\\")
has_special_chars <- function(x) {
  Reduce(`|`, lapply(latex_specials, function(char) str_detect(x, fixed(char))))
}

# Escape character columns that contain special LaTeX characters
df_clean <- df_clean %>%
  mutate(across(where(is.character), ~ifelse(has_special_chars(.x),
                                             cell_spec(.x, "latex", escape = TRUE),
                                             .x)))

# Merge Mean + P5/P95 into display columns, with red highlighting for NPBV P5 < 0
df_clean <- df_clean |>
  dplyr::mutate(
    Impact = paste0(round(.data[["Impact Mean"]], 2), " [",
                    round(.data[["Impact P5"]], 2), ", ",
                    round(.data[["Impact P95"]], 2), "]"),
    Offset = paste0(round(.data[["Offset Mean"]], 2), " [",
                    round(.data[["Offset P5"]], 2), ", ",
                    round(.data[["Offset P95"]], 2), "]"),
    NPBV   = ifelse(.data[["NPBV P5"]] < 0,
                    cell_spec(paste0(round(.data[["NPBV Mean"]], 2), " [",
                                    round(.data[["NPBV P5"]], 2), ", ",
                                    round(.data[["NPBV P95"]], 2), "]"),
                              "latex", color = "red", bold = FALSE),
                    paste0(round(.data[["NPBV Mean"]], 2), " [",
                           round(.data[["NPBV P5"]], 2), ", ",
                           round(.data[["NPBV P95"]], 2), "]"))
  ) |>
  dplyr::select(-dplyr::matches("Mean|P5|P95"))

# Build LaTeX table
df_clean |>
  kbl(booktabs = TRUE, escape = FALSE,  # escape = FALSE required for cell_spec
      caption = "Biodiversity Offset Scenario Results Summary") |>
  kable_styling(latex_options = c("striped", "hold_position"), font_size = 9)

knitr::asis_output("\\end{landscape}")


```

```{r, results='asis', echo=FALSE, warning=FALSE}
# ===============================
# Detailed Tables
# ===============================

if(params$long_report) { 
  
  suppressPackageStartupMessages({
    library(knitr)
    library(kableExtra)
    library(dplyr)
    library(tidyr)
    library(purrr)
  })
  
  df_clean <- params$saved_results_df
  
  # Tell LaTeX to make table labels and captions bold
  knitr::asis_output("\\captionsetup[table]{labelfont=bf,textfont=bf}\n")
  
  for (i in seq_len(nrow(df_clean))) {
    
    row_data <- df_clean[i, ] |>
      mutate(across(everything(), as.character)) 
    
    row_data <- as_tibble(cbind(nms = names(row_data), t(row_data)))
    colnames(row_data) <- c("Parameter", "Value")
    
    knitr::asis_output(paste0(
      "\\begin{landscape}\n",
      "\\noindent\n",
      "\\begin{mytitleboxL}\n",
      "\\Large\\bfseries\\color{white} Appendix A: Detailed Results (Row ", i, ")\n",
      "\\end{mytitleboxL}\n\n"
    ))
    
    print(
      row_data |>
        kbl(booktabs = TRUE, 
            caption = paste0("Biodiversity Offset Detailed Results: Calculation ", i),
            row.names = FALSE,
            longtable = TRUE) %>%
        kable_styling(latex_options = c("striped"), font_size = 9) %>%
        column_spec(1, width = "4cm") %>%
        column_spec(2, width = "10cm")
    )
    
    
    knitr::asis_output(
      "\\end{landscape}\n\\clearpage\n"
    )
  }
  
}



```
